Aqua Platform Pricing
The Aqua platform is a unified Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP) that secures your applications from development to production, across multiple clouds and platforms, enabling you to identify, prioritize, and reduce risks throughout each stage of your software development life cycle (SDLC).
Dev Security
Comprehensive software supply chain security for your CI/CD pipeline and toolchain

Cloud Security
Agentless and agent-based visibility and risk assessment for public cloud and K8s environments, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and real-time runtime protection for cloud workloads (CWPP).

Advanced malware protection with malware blocking and deletion
Service identity-based segmentation (firewall)
Event audit trails, incidents view, and response policies

Aqua Security
Aqua Security is the pioneer in securing containerized cloud native applications from development to production. Aqua's full lifecycle solution prevents attacks by enforcing pre-deployment hygiene and mitigates attacks in real time in production, reducing mean time to repair and overall business risk. The Aqua Platform, a Cloud Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP), integrates security from Code to Cloud, combining the power of agent and agentless technology into a single solution. With enterprise scale that doesn’t slow development pipelines, Aqua secures your future in the cloud. Founded in 2015, Aqua is headquartered in Boston, MA and Ramat Gan, IL protecting over 500 of the world’s largest enterprises.
